facts.text: Hotel occupies the uppermost floors of the Yingkai Square Tower, steps from the Pearl River embankment.
facts.excerpt: Set on the uppermost floors of the Yingkai Square Tower, steps from the Pearl River embankment

facts.text: The interiors are by Tokyo-based design firm Super Potato.
facts.excerpt: Envisioned by Tokyo-based design firm Super Potato

facts.text: The interior design draws on the cultural heritage of the Lingnan region.
facts.excerpt: Drawing inspiration from the rich cultural heritage of the Lingnan region

facts.text: The R&F Yingkai Square tower was designed by Chicago-based architecture firm Goettsch Partners.
facts.excerpt: Designed by the renowned Chicago-based architecture firm Goettsch Partners

facts.text: The hotel displays works by Japanese artist Tadashi Kawamata made from reclaimed wood, inspired by the dragons of Baiyun Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Japanese artist Tadashi Kawamata’s masterful creations, crafted from reclaimed wood

facts.text: Canton Tower view rooms face south across the Pearl River toward the Canton Tower.
facts.excerpt: Facing south, guests are treated to an unobstructed view of the iconic 604-meter-high Canton Tower (1,981 feet) across the Pearl River

facts.text: Rooms have a marble bathroom with a deep soaking tub with television, double vanity and rain shower.
facts.excerpt: The marble bathroom, opened by a sliding partition, features a deep soaking tub with television, double vanity, and rain shower.

facts.text: Connecting room pairs share a private entrance foyer set apart from the main guestroom corridor.
facts.excerpt: These two 52 sqm rooms share a private entrance foyer set apart from the main guestroom corridor.

facts.text: Yue Jing Xuan serves Cantonese cuisine from an open kitchen.
facts.excerpt: guests are enveloped by the rhythmic symphony of chefs in the open kitchen, each movement showcasing century-old Cantonese recipes

facts.text: Yue Jing Xuan has been Michelin Guide Selected from 2018 to 2026.
facts.excerpt: ★ 2018-2026 \| Michelin Guide “Selected”

facts.text: The Dining Room serves Mediterranean cuisine and Italian wines.
facts.excerpt: As guests savor exquisite Italian wines and flavorful Mediterranean cuisine

facts.text: The Roof Bar has an outdoor terrace and live music.
facts.excerpt: The Roof Bar beckons with its outdoor terrace high above the city and live music

facts.text: The Living Room offers afternoon tea and curated workshops.
facts.excerpt: with curated workshops and ever-evolving afternoon tea displays celebrating the city's rich heritage

facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: Open 24 Hours

facts.text: Kids menus are offered at all venues, and cribs plus kids bathrobes and slippers are provided.
facts.excerpt: From baby cribs to kids bathrobes and slippers, we provide everything needed for a comfortable stay. Our kids menus at all venues

facts.text: The Spa is bathed in natural light high above the city.
facts.excerpt: Bathed in natural light high above the city, The Spa at Park Hyatt Guangzhou is a sanctuary of warmth and calm.

facts.text: The hotel is directly connected to Zhujiang New Town metro station, served by lines 3 and 5.
facts.excerpt: Directly connected to Zhujiang New Town metro station, served by lines 3 and 5

facts.text: Self-parking is in the basement of Yingkai Square Tower with direct elevator access to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: self-parking is available in the basement of Yingkai Square Tower, accessible from Zhujiang West 4th Street with direct elevator access to the hotel

facts.text: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport is 40 kilometers away, about 45 to 60 minutes by car depending on traffic.
facts.excerpt: Travel time is approximately 45–60 minutes, depending on traffic conditions.

facts.text: During the Spring and Autumn Canton Fair the hotel runs a shuttle to the Canton Fair Complex.
facts.excerpt: During the Spring and Autumn Canton Fair, Park Hyatt Guangzhou offers a dedicated shuttle service to and from the Canton Fair Complex.

facts.text: Canton Tower stands across the Pearl River within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: Canton Tower, stands across the Pearl River within walking distance

facts.text: The hotel offers meeting Salons on the 66th floor with floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 66th floor, the Salons offer uninterrupted city views through floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: Certain room amenities are discontinued or only available on request for sustainability.
facts.excerpt: certain room amenities are discontinued or only available on request

facts.text: Hotel rises 286 metres above the central business district.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Guangzhou rises 286 metres above Guangzhou’s central business district

facts.text: The R&F Yingkai Square tower rises 296 meters.
facts.excerpt: this towering landmark rises 296 meters into the sky

facts.text: Hotel occupies the top 14 floors of the R&F Yingkai Square skyscraper.
facts.excerpt: Occupying the top 14 floors of the R&F Yingkai Square skyscraper

facts.text: Guestrooms and suites occupy floors 53 through 62 of the tower.
